messages.content: You are a senior code reviewer.

Review deleteProject(projectId). It deletes project row before deleting tasks and files, causing foreign key errors. Required fix: wrap in db.transaction, soft delete project.deleted_at, mark tasks.status='archived', enqueue file_cleanup job with delay_seconds=300, and require confirmText exactly equals project.name. Also emit project_deleted audit event with actor_id.
deleteProject order bug: use transaction, soft delete deleted_at, archive tasks, enqueue file_cleanup delay 300s, exact confirmText, audit project_deleted actor_id.
